content.title: How to watch Thunder vs. Nuggets: TV channel and streaming options for April 10
content.text: The Denver Nuggets (52-28) will attempt to build on a 10-game win streak when they host the Oklahoma City Thunder (64-16) on April 10, 2026. The Thunder have won seven games in a row.How to watch Oklahoma City Thunder vs. Denver Nuggets Venue: Ball Arena Time: 9 p.m. ET TV: ALT, FDSOK Streaming (in-market viewers): Fubo (try for free) Streaming (out-of-market viewers): NBA League Pass Watching in person?
